mains_claim_correction.original: Local consent, language access and livelihood security matter alongside roads and schooling.
mains_claim_correction.revised: Meaningful consultation, language access and livelihood security matter alongside roads and schooling. PESA section 4(i) requires consultation for specified land acquisition and rehabilitation decisions; it does not itself create an unconditional veto. Any stronger consent requirement must be established from the separately applicable law.
mains_claim_correction.reason: The previous unqualified 'local consent' could incorrectly imply that PESA 4(i) itself mandates an unconditional veto. Corrected the source model answer and integrated editable master in lockstep.
